Title: New extension shows virtual machine info

Body.Content: The recent VM Agent release includes an extension that displays Windows virtual machine info on the desktop of the VM instance (when you RDP into it). It's a quick way to see VM configuration settings (internal and public IP, disk space, memory, deployment ID, etc).
